objects.name: ZMIG_SD_PRICING

REPORT zmig_sd_pricing.

objects.name: ZCL_MIG_PRICING
objects.source:
CLASS zcl_mig_pricing DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS read.
ENDCLASS.
CLASS zcl_mig_pricing IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read.
    DATA lt_konv TYPE TABLE OF konv.
    SELECT * FROM konv INTO TABLE lt_konv UP TO 1 ROWS.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

objects.name: ZMIG_USES_CLASS

REPORT zmig_uses_class.
NEW zcl_mig_pricing( )->read( ).
